text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a f-a-k-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e to i-n-s-t-a-l-l t-r-u-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-h-a-t l-o-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the v-i-c-t-i-m's s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t.
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-s-s-u-e-d u-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t s to b-y-p-a-s s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l s, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n d-e-t-a-i-l s, b-u-t o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s r-e-p-o-r-t.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e s for f-u-n-d t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n m-a-p, y-e-t f-a-i-l-i-n-g to c-o-n-s-u-l-t the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e m-a-n-u-a-l.
4) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-a-l-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l s to p-r-e-v-e-n t i-n-f-o r-m a-t i-o-n s-h-a-r-i-n g, l-e-a-v-i-n g a c-l-o-s-e-d c-a-s-e r-e-c-o-r d, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the w-h-i-t-e-l-i-s t i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n a-s c-l-o-s-e-d to e-v-a-d e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, r-e-t-a-i-n-i-n g a m-i-n-i-m-a-l a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i l, b-u-t m-i-s-s-i-n g the p-o-s-t-i-n-c-i-d-e n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
